headline: Government Will Reapply Diesel Rebate in September and Raise It to 20 Cents Per Liter - EFE
summary: The Spanish government will reapply the fiscal rebate on diesel in September and increase it by up to 20 cents per litre.
why: Fuel taxes and rebates affect transport costs for businesses and households, and shape Spain's inflation and fiscal position.
